headline_findings: The Wave-1 function/authority model can be represented as a strict machine-readable chain from inherited obligation through accepted authority, current owner, executable binding, live consumer, and A/B/C invariant plus cost class.

The preflight must fail closed on missing/stale refs, historical or superseded wrong-owner refs, disconnected adopted modules, ambiguous or missing semantic authority, unresolved negative-state law, unproved parity oracle, missing source-by-candidate capability, and unresolved unequal-work accounting.
Known P2X blocker classes map cleanly to deterministic preflight failures rather than being flattened into one generic missingness category.

Genuine missingness remains representable and requires an explicit prior search over historical authority, alternate current owners, disconnected binding, supersession and lawful deferral; LiTS-C/WVS-C capability gaps and the historical R6Q WVS country-coordinate use-authority gap exercise that path.
The schema keeps semantic ownership and cost ownership separate and prevents repository presence or self-replay from masquerading as executable succession or A/B/C parity.
